name: Infantry_Calendar
author: Infantry AI
description: A planner for the user: tasks and reminders that the user and every agent can add. Daemon half (tables, store, agent tools, frames); the Calendar tab comes later.

knowledge.summary: Calendar: add tasks and reminders for the user, a role or a session (infantry_calendar_add, infantry_calendar_timer); list with infantry_calendar_list.
Calendar: you are the user's front desk. Put what they ask you to remember on their calendar (infantry_calendar_add) and read it back (infantry_calendar_list).

config.title: Calendar: limits
config.applies: Applies to: how long a calendar title or note may be, how many items a list returns, how much history is kept.

fields.label: Time zone for items (IANA name, empty = this computer's)

tools.name: infantry_calendar_add
tools.description: Add a task or a reminder to the user's calendar. kind task|reminder, title, optional notes, date (yyyy-MM-dd) + time (HH:mm) or inMinutes or allDay, remindAt (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm) or remindBefore (minutes), target (role:<role> | session:<id>; omitted = the user), projectId, zone.

tools.name: infantry_calendar_timer
tools.description: A reminder `minutes` from now: title, minutes, optional target (role:<role> | session:<id>; omitted = the user).

tools.name: infantry_calendar_list
tools.description: List calendar items: optional from/to (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive), status, kind, projectId, createdBy (an agent id, or user).

tools.name: infantry_calendar_get
tools.description: One calendar item by id, with its history.

tools.name: infantry_calendar_update
tools.description: Change a calendar item: id plus any of title, notes, date, time, allDay, remindAt, remindBefore, target, projectId.

tools.name: infantry_calendar_complete
tools.description: Mark a calendar item done (default) or cancelled: id, optional status done|cancelled.
